content:
marisol: :rotating_light: getting paged — spike in 5xxs for inference-api but traces and logs are mostly missing in Datadog. metrics look delayed. anyone else seeing blank panels?
eli: saw the alert. Datadog traces are showing ingestion delays, spans delayed by ~10m for some hosts. logs also lagging.
datadog-bot: Datadog status: Investigating — https://status.datadoghq.com/ (ingest delay ongoing)
joel: confirming from our side — Cloud watch metrics are still OK, but our dashboards source is dd. switching to cloud metrics view now.
marisol: quick triage: is this a full Datadog outage or partial ingest delay? need to know paging escalation and customer impact.
eli: looks like ingestion delay across EU regions based on traces. host-level metrics and appmetrics (via cloud) are fine. spans/traces and log ingestion delayed. cause unknown.
kate: customer-support seeing a few reports of slow response pages from customers, some are hysterical because our frontend graphs are blank. we should send a comms mitigation note.
marisol: ACTIONS: 1) set incident channel, 2) switch critical alerts to backup sources, 3) contact datadog support + watch status, 4) start customer impact assessment. assigning.
marisol: @eli you take on mitigation (alerts/fallback), @joel pls do support comms coordination, i'll run impact assessment and contact eng-oncall for any hotfixes.
eli: switching alerts now — updating PagerDuty rules to point to Prometheus/cloudwatch metrics for latency/error-rate. will cron a script to flip thresholds for the next 2 hours.
eli: running command to flip alert targets:

```
# flip dd-backed alerts to cloud provider metrics
for a in $(cat critical_alerts.txt); do pd-tool update --id $a --target cloudwatch; done
```

eli: done — new alerts will fire from cloudwatch. leaving existing DD alerts enabled for visibility once ingestion resumes.
joel: prepping a short customer blurb — will share draft: "We're currently investigating delayed observability data from Datadog which may make our dashboards appear incomplete. The inference service is operating but some monitoring and traces may be delayed. We're monitoring via cloud metrics and will update."
kate: please include impact matrix: which customers have only dd-based dashboards vs those with backup. I can pull list from support tooling.
marisol: I see increased 503s for inference-api at edge ~+2% above baseline since t-8m. tie that to request routing changes?
eli: checking recent deploys — deploy-bot: deploy finished 1769001200 (inference-api v3.14.2)
deploy-bot: Deployed inference-api v3.14.2 to prod at 1769001200 by joel
eli: deploy looks fine. no rollout flags. logs from pods are delayed in dd; checking pod logs directly: `kubectl logs -n prod inference-api-*/ -c inference | tail -n 200`
eli: quick grep shows increased 5xx from backend auth provider failures (401/502). hitting auth providers concurrently could amplify errors and slow retries — but not enough to explain blank dashboards.
marisol: ok, so two problems: (A) Datadog ingest delay causing observability blind spots, (B) auth provider errors causing real customer-facing errors. handle both.
joel: I've posted the customer blurb in status page draft and support threads. linking to internal status: https://status.redwood.example/incident/1769002222
customer-impact-bot: Customers affected: ~12 accounts reported slow responses; 3 enterprise customers flagged as "high impact".
kate: pinging account leads for those 3. will open escalation tickets.
eli: mitigation for auth provider: temporarily route auth calls to fallback token-service (v2) with lower latencies. rolling a config change now.
eli: `kubectl set env deploy/inference-api AUTH_BACKEND=token-service-v2 -n prod` -> rolling update initiated.
eli: rollback plan ready if it worsens. monitoring cloudwatch for auth latency.
marisol: datadog support response?
datadog-bot: Support ticket 789123 opened. Datadog: "we're seeing higher-than-normal log/tracing ingestion times due to internal backlog. engineering on it." ETA unknown.
marisol: put a note in incident channel to not rely on dd dashboards for next 1h. use cloudwatch/prometheus and direct pod logs (kubectl).
joel: support comms published to customer Slack and status page. included workaround: "If you rely on our dashboards, data may be delayed; your service metrics are still being captured by cloud metrics and we will provide raw logs if needed."
kate: capturing customer impact matrix now — PS teams looped for the 3 enterprise customers. scheduled join-in-call if SLA impact.
eli: auth fallback looks stable so far, error rate dropping to baseline in last 3m. inference 5xx delta reduced to +0.4%.
marisol: good. we should still complete a full RCA for both the auth provider errors and the dd ingestion delay correlation.
joel: next steps: 1) keep monitoring, 2) keep alerts on cloudwatch, 3) wait for Datadog clear, 4) postmortem to include timelines and what dashboards lack backup. assigning to eli+joel.
marisol: Handoff: i'm going offline in ~20m. @eli you'll be primary oncall; @joel you'll own external comms. please update thread when you hand off.
eli: Roger. I'll stay on for next 2 hours and then pass to night shift. I'll also collect timeline snippets for the postmortem.
joel: I've updated the status page and notified account leads. will do a scheduled update in 30m or sooner if anything changes.
datadog-bot: Status update: ingestion queue improving, delays reducing to ~2m.
marisol: thanks team. putting an incident summary in ticket and closing if dd resolves and error rates remain stable for 30m.
eli: leaving a quick checklist for post-incident: [ ] add dd ingest delay playbook, [ ] ensure critical dashboards have cloudwatch fallback, [ ] create synthetic canary to detect dd ingestion silently, [ ] review auth provider retry/backoff config.
joel: adding comms follow-up: schedule customer follow-up emails and post-incident note for enterprise accounts.
marisol: :thumbsup: good work. handoff time now — eli owning.
eli: taking over. will update thread with final status and attach timeline.
marisol: (left channel)
eli: final update at 1769002822: Datadog ingestion improved and traces/logs backfilled, auth fallback stable, error rates normalized. closing incident with follow-up tasks assigned.
